page.layout: One page of text, dense block, probably in columns; a short line at the top that may be a heading. Scan resolution too low to identify margins, notes, running head or page number.
page.notes: The scan is a low-resolution thumbnail. Words, numbers, margins and any notes cannot be read. Please upload a larger or higher-resolution image of this page (ideally at least 2000 px on the long side, with the full page visible) and I will transcribe it in full.
